title: Word RAM instructions
statement: A word RAM instruction is one of the following: write $1$ to register $i$; write the sum, difference, or product of the words in registers $j$ and $k$ to register $i$; load into register $i$ the word stored at the address held in register $j$; store the word in register $j$ at the address held in register $i$; jump to program position $l$ if register $i$ contains a negative integer; accept; or reject. Register indices are integers and jump targets are natural numbers.
